request: Monthly forecast of Tito's vodka bottles in Polk County for the next 5 months

spec.title: Tito's Vodka, Polk County, next 5 months

sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date AS month,
       'total' AS series,
       SUM(il.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = il.store_no
JOIN sales.item i ON i.item_no = il.item_no
WHERE s.county_fips = '19153'
  AND i.item_desc LIKE 'TITOS HANDMADE VODKA%'
  AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
assumptions: Tito's Vodka identified by item description starting with 'TITOS HANDMADE VODKA' (all sizes: 1.75L, 1L, 750ml, 375ml, 200ml, 100ml, 50ml minis), vendor Fifth Generation Distilled Spirits.
Polk County identified via store county_fips = 19153.
Measure is total bottles sold (sales_bottles), which accounts for mini-packs correctly.
History includes all months from 2016-01-01 onward; incomplete latest month will be dropped by downstream processing.
Forecast horizon is 5 months as requested.

request: How many bottles of each Tito's mini item will sell statewide over the next 6 months?

spec.title: Tito's mini items, statewide, next 6 months

product.label: Tito's Handmade Vodka Mini and Mini 4 Pack

sql:
select date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date as month,
       i.item_desc as series,
       sum(il.sales_bottles) as value
from sales.invoice_line il
join sales.item i on i.item_no = il.item_no
where il.item_no in ('38194','38185')
  and il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
group by 1,2
order by 1
assumptions: Interpreted 'Tito's mini' items as the two matching products: TITOS HANDMADE VODKA MINI (50ml, item 38194) and TITOS HANDMADE VODKA MINI 4 PACK (50ml, item 38185).
Each item is forecast as its own series (bottles sold, statewide, all stores/counties combined).
sales_bottles already accounts for multi-packs (counts each mini bottle), so 4-pack units are converted to individual bottle counts.
History starts 2016-01-01 as required; incomplete current month will be dropped by downstream processing.
No renumbering/family consolidation needed since both items have family_item_no equal to their own item_no.

request: American vodka sales dollars for each of the five largest counties, next 6 months

spec.title: American Vodka dollars, top 5 counties, next 6 months

region.label: Polk, Linn, Scott, Johnson, Black Hawk counties

       s.county_name AS series,
       SUM(il.sales_dollars) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.item i ON il.item_no = i.item_no

  AND s.county_name IN ('POLK','LINN','SCOTT','JOHNSON','BLACK HAWK')

Monthly history starts 2016-01-01; incomplete current month will be dropped downstream

request: How many bottles of whiskey will Ames stores order next month?

spec.title: Whiskey bottles, Ames stores, next month

sql:
select date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date as month,
       'total' as series,
       sum(il.sales_bottles) as value
from sales.invoice_line il
join sales.item it on it.item_no = il.item_no
join sales.store s on s.store_no = il.store_no
join sales.category c on c.category_code = it.category_current
where s.city = 'AMES'
  and c.category_name ilike '%whiskies%'
group by 1
order by 1
assumptions: City 'Ames' maps to Iowa stores located in Ames, Story County, using sales.store.city = 'AMES'.

Whiskey is defined as all true whiskey categories (American, Blended, Straight Bourbon, Single Barrel Bourbon, Tennessee, Straight Rye, Corn, Iowa Distillery, Imported, Canadian, Scotch, Irish) using the item's current category (category_current) so renamed/renumbered products are classified consistently over time.
Excluded 'Whiskey Liqueur' since it is a liqueur product line rather than a true whiskey.
Measure is bottles ordered (sales_bottles), summed by calendar month across all Ames stores combined (one total series).
History starts 2016-01-01 as required; the current partial month will be dropped by downstream processing.
Forecast horizon is 1 month (next month) as requested.
